records.source: This can be planted to grow a special tree.
records.translation: Maaaring itanim ito upang magpatubo ng natatanging puno.

records.englishResidueReason: Napalm is a conventional technical loanword in Filipino.

records.source: When you defeat an enemy, they explode.
records.translation: Sumasabog ang mga kalaban kapag tinalo mo sila.

records.englishResidueReason: Nautilus is the proper scientific genus name for this shell-bearing animal.

records.source: This must've washed up ages ago from an ancient coral reef.
records.translation: Malamang natangay ito mula sa sinaunang bahura at napadpad sa pampang noong napakatagal nang panahon.

records.source: The delicate shards form a tiny pink meadow.
records.translation: Bumubuo ng munting parang na kulay rosas ang maseselang tipak.

records.preserveReason: Neptunite is the proper mineral name used in Filipino references.

records.source: A jet-black crystal that is unusually reflective.
records.translation: Ubod-itim na kristal na pambihirang makintab.

records.source: A sticky, fragrant substance derived from oak sap.
records.translation: Malagkit at mabangong sangkap na nagmumula sa katas ng roble.

records.source: A volcanic glass that forms when lava cools rapidly.
records.translation: Bulkanikong salaming nabubuo kapag mabilis lumamig ang lava.
records.englishResidueReason: Lava is a conventional geological loanword in Filipino.

records.source: An old legend claims these stones are the mosaics of ancient mermaids.
records.translation: Ayon sa matandang alamat, mga mosaiko ng mga sinaunang sirena ang mga batong ito.
Langis na panluto para sa lahat ng gamit.

records.source: Drink this and weaker monsters will avoid you.
records.translation: Inumin ito at iiwasan ka ng mas mahihinang halimaw.

records.preserveReason: Omelet is the conventional Filipino food name used consistently throughout the existing recipe and dialogue text.

records.source: A blacksmith can break this open for you. These geodes contain a wide variety of minerals.
records.translation: Maaaring buksan ito para sa iyo ng panday. Maraming iba't ibang mineral ang laman ng mga heodang ito.

records.englishResidueReason: Omni Heoda is the canonical Filipino glossary term for this universal geode type.

records.source: Break apart to obtain omni geodes.
records.translation: Basagin upang makakuha ng mga Omni Heoda.

records.preserveReason: Opal is the conventional Filipino mineral loanword used consistently in Fire Opal.

records.source: Its internal structure causes it to reflect a rainbow of light.
records.translation: Dahil sa panloob na kayarian nito, sinasalamin nito ang bahagharing liwanag.

records.source: Juicy, tangy, and bursting with sweet summer aroma.
records.translation: Makatas, maasim-asim, at hitik sa matamis na halimuyak ng tag-init.

records.source: Takes 28 days to produce a mature Orange tree. Bears fruit in the summer. Only grows if the 8 surrounding "tiles" are empty.
records.translation: Tumatagal ng 28 araw upang maging ganap na puno ng Kahel. Namumunga sa tag-init. Lumalaki lamang kung walang laman ang 8 nakapaligid na "parisukat".

records.source: This exquisite fan most likely belonged to a noblewoman. Historians believe that the valley was a popular sixth-era vacation spot for the wealthy.
records.translation: Malamang pag-aari ng isang maharlikang babae ang napakagandang pamaypay na ito. Naniniwala ang mga historyador na sikat na bakasyunan ng mayayaman ang lambak noong Ikaanim na Kapanahunan.

records.source: A fancy necklace found in the water outside of the bath house. It's still wet...
records.translation: Marangyang kuwintas na natagpuan sa tubig sa labas ng Bahay-Paliguan. Basa pa ito...
